Based on the screenshot provided, here is the description of the header:

*   **Shape:** The header is **not** a floating rounded pill. It is a **full-width horizontal bar** that spans the entire top of the interface.
*   **Opacity & Background Content:** The header is **opaque (solid white)**. You **cannot** see video content scrolling behind it; it completely blocks whatever content would be underneath.

**Visual Details:**
The header features a light gray background with a distinct, rounded search bar in the center (containing "Mashhad" and "Search"). It also displays a row of channel recommendations (e.g., Apex Gaming, Pixel Forge) above the main category filters (All, Music, Gaming, etc.). The bottom navigation bar (Home, Shorts, Subscriptions) appears to be a separate element at the very bottom of the screen.
